summary: Added dev_supervisor/text_worker.py: bounded text-only worker (summarise, classify, extract_json, review_notes) over the local OmniRoute client. Free-route allowlist (gemini/, groq/), route order from a benchmark file (pass rate, then latency) or default list, 1 same-route retry for timeout/upstream/connection, immediate fallback on rate_limited/not_found/auth_error/check_failed, total attempts capped at 8, deterministic checkers, result labelled REPORTED until the checker passes then CHECKED (never VERIFIED). No tool use (Gemini thought_signature limitation recorded in the module docstring). 49 offline tests with a fake transport. OBSERVED live: one CHECKED run per kind on gemini/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (6.6 s, 8.0 s, 9.9 s, 8.7 s total latency) and one fallback (groq/openai/gpt-oss-20b auth_error HTTP 403 5.4 s, then gemini/gemini-3.1-flash-lite ok 2.0 s). 5 live calls total. NOT VERIFIED beyond that: single run, synthetic inputs only.
